# nxos security Nexus captures

The captures dated 2026-11-18 UTC were taken with `netops-ro` on Nexus 9300v NX-OS 9.3(12) through separate pinned SSH CLI sessions. Files without the qualifiers below came from nexus9300v. The two `*_unsupported.out` files came from nexus-peer-a (CLI rc 16). The Nexus 9300v, NX-OS 9.3(12) empty named ACL and empty VLAN 20 DAI statistics are successful CLI reads (rc 0).

Source commands are recorded in a private measurement record (not published). Fixtures were anonymized in one pass with `tests/support/anonymize_fixture.py --check` and trailing whitespace was removed.

- `acl_hits.out` and `acl_port.out` contain CLI data from the Cisco DevNet Nexus 9000 NX-API CLI Reference, 7.x, `show ip access-list acl-2 expand` and `show ip access-list acl-2 summary`. [Source](https://developer.cisco.com/docs/nx-api-cli-reference-for-the-cisco-nexus-9000-series-platform/access-list-commands/)
- `bindings_populated.out` and `dai_counters.out` contain CLI data from Cisco's Nexus 9000 9.3(x) DAI guide, `show ip dhcp snooping binding` and `show ip arp inspection statistics vlan 1`. [Source](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/td/docs/switches/datacenter/nexus9000/sw/93x/security/configuration/guide/b-cisco-nexus-9000-nx-os-security-configuration-guide-93x/b-cisco-nexus-9000-nx-os-security-configuration-guide-93x_chapter_010000.html)
- `nd_wrapped.out` is derived from the wrapped Vlan502 row and heading in Cisco's `show ipv6 adjacency` sample. Introductory lines and unrelated rows were omitted, and the entry total was set to one for the single displayed row. [Source](https://developer.cisco.com/docs/cisco-nexus-9000-series-nx-api-cli-reference/latest/ipv6-commands/)
- `bindings_static.out` renders Table 5 of Cisco's NX-OS 9.3(x) DHCP guide as a CLI table. Client IPs were changed to documentation addresses. [Source](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/td/docs/switches/datacenter/nexus9000/sw/93x/security/configuration/guide/b-cisco-nexus-9000-nx-os-security-configuration-guide-93x/b-cisco-nexus-9000-nx-os-security-configuration-guide-93x_chapter_01110.html#)
- `mac_vxlan_vlan.out` uses the four rows of LEAF A's `show mac address-table vlan 10` under “Troubleshoot” in Cisco's VXLAN BGP EVPN article. Prompts and legend were omitted, and MAC and peer IP values were anonymized. [Source](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/docs/switches/nexus-9000-series-switches/214624-configure-system-nve-infra-vlans-in-vxla.html)
- The pager regression cuts `relay_stats.out` after the first six lines and adds `--More--`. The stderr regressions reuse the blank `dai_vlan.out` capture and simulate a separate SSH stderr channel carrying the recorded `dai_unsupported.out` diagnostic or the three diagnostic forms listed in the review.
